reports.title: Portland General Electric Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: Revising 2026 adjusted earnings guidance to $3.18 to $3.28 per diluted share, due to the impact of unusually mild weather during the third quarter; long-term guidance remains intact
PGE expects participation to provide meaningful customer value, including approximately $14 million in estimated customer savings in 2027.
PGE is revising its full-year 2026 adjusted earnings guidance to $3.18 to $3.28 per diluted share based on the following assumptions:
The capital forecast is: Biglow: $63M in 2026; $351M in 2027; $342M in 2028; and $144M in 2029.Salmonfly: $78M in 2026; $459M in 2027; $222M in 2028; and $94M in 2029.
